summary: Một VPN phân tán đơn giản sử dụng WireGuard để kết nối an toàn giữa các peer mà không cần server trung tâm.
usecases: Secure P2P connectivity for remote teams without central servers
Bypass NAT and geographic restrictions for accessing local network resources
Low-latency mesh networking for IoT devices and online gaming
ideas: Integrate with blockchain for a fully decentralized, trustless VPN network
Develop a mobile client for one-click mesh VPN connections similar to Tailscale
Use as the networking layer for distributed compute clusters or edge AI networks
